lessons.culture: Saudi families take their long holidays in summer and at the two Eids, and many Jeddah families drive up the Red Sea coast to Yanbu or Umluj, or up to the cool mountains of Taif and Abha. Trips are made with the whole family, and the photos go straight to the family group chat on everyone's جوّال.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: "كيف كانت الرحلة؟" Say really lovely, we had a great time.

too_formal.feedback: Written Arabic. In Jeddah: مرّة حلوة، استانسنا.

exercises.tip: استانسنا (istaanasna), "we had a great time", is very common in Saudi speech.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "حاخد الكاميرا _____." (I will take my camera with me.)
exercises.tip: حـ before the verb is the future: حاخد, "I will take".

exercises.prompt: Complete: "_____ لي الصور على جوّالي." (Send me the photos on my phone.)
exercises.tip: جوّال (jawwaal) is the Saudi word for a mobile phone.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "Where are you going this holiday?" (to a man)

too_formal.item: إلى أين ستسافر في هذه العطلة؟
too_formal.feedback: Written Arabic. Spoken: فين حتسافر الإجازة دي؟

exercises.tip: In Saudi Arabia a holiday is usually called إجازة (ijaaza).

exercises.prompt: Translate: "Can you take a photo of us?" (to a man)

too_formal.item: هل يمكنك أن تلتقط لنا صورة؟
too_formal.feedback: Written Arabic. Spoken: ممكن تصوّرنا؟

exercises.prompt: Which one means "The sunset is beautiful here"?
Which word means "camera"?
Put the words in order: "كلّهم / الأهل / مع / حنسافر" (We are travelling with the whole family.)
Put the words in order: "البحر / من / قريب / بيت / حجزنا" (We booked a house near the beach.)
exercises.tip: Saudis often say البحر, "the sea", for the beach.

challenge.title: احجز سفرة وحل مشكلة
challenge.instructions: اعمل حوار قصير: احجز غرفة بفندق أو تذكرة سفر، وبعدين ظهرت مشكلة (تأخير، شنطة ضايعة، أو الرحلة فاتتك) واحكي كيف حليتها.
required_elements: طلب حجز أو تذكرة بجملة كاملة

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.english: Hello, I want to book a ticket to Riyadh.

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.transliteration: ray7 bas walla ray7 wa jaay?
dialogue.english: One-way or round trip?

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.english: Round trip, how much?

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.english: One hundred and fifty riyals.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: للأسف فاتني الباص، في باص ثاني؟
dialogue.transliteration: lal2asaf faatni l-baaS, fi baaS thanee?
dialogue.english: Unfortunately I missed the bus, is there another one?

dialogue.speaker: الموظف
dialogue.arabic: ما تخاف، في باص ثاني بعد ساعة
dialogue.transliteration: ma tkhaaf, fi baaS thanee ba3d saa3a
dialogue.english: Don't worry, there's another bus in an hour.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.english: Thank God, thanks a lot.
